treatment.name: Dental Filling
treatment.overview: Fillings repair cavities or chips by restoring form and function using tooth-colored materials.

types.name: Glass Ionomer (GIC)
description: Releases fluoride; useful in specific cases.

cost.note: Price depends on size and location of the cavity.

during: Decay removal under anesthesia if needed.
after: Temporary bite sensitivity can occur for a few days.
Normal use once numbness wears off.

avoid: Chewing while numb to prevent cheek/tongue bites
prefer: Resume normal diet after anesthesia fades

cons: Cavity enlarges; may need RCT or crown later
Pain, infection, and tooth fracture risks increase
prosConsOfSkipping.summary: Early fillings are simple, affordable, and prevent bigger problems.

faq.a: 5-10 years on average; good hygiene extends lifespan.
Tooth-colored composites blend with natural enamel.
